author: GoldenProsper Games
title: Hiring 3D Character Artist (Anime Style, Freelance/Contract)
content: GoldenProsper Games is hiring: 3D Character Artist (Anime Style, Freelance/Contract). About us: GoldenProsper Games is an independent game studio from Indonesia building a stylized anime game. Our character designs and art direction are locked, and we are looking for a 3D character artist to bring them to life. The role: You will turn our finished character sheets into game-ready 3D models that match our illustrated art direction. Compensation: Rp3,300,000 – 4,000,000 (about USD 185–225) per character, fixed price, paid per milestone. How to apply: Fill in the form. Deadline: 30 october. Contact via docs.google.com form.

author: Andrew Mulholland
title: Looking for 2D artists for commander portraits and UI
content: [PAID] Looking for 2D artists for commander portraits, game icons and UI for an unannounced sci-fi strategy game. Hunted Cow Games (huntedcow.com) is looking for freelance artists for an unannounced sci-fi strategy game on Steam and mobile. We need about 30 commander portraits (initially) and a lot of icons, covering skills, currencies, items and more. We're also looking for a UI artist to design the game's interface skin: frames, buttons, panels, HUD and faction branding. The style is polished, semi-realistic digital painting: clean industrial sci-fi, cool metals, cyan glows and dark space tones. No AI art of any kind. To apply, please email outsourcing@huntedcow.com with your portfolio, what you're interested in, your rates and your availability.

author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!

author: Geek Realm Hub
title: Pokémon Company hiring full-time Pokémon Sleep illustrator
content: The Pokémon Company is hiring a full-time Pokémon Sleep illustrator! Dream job alert for Pokémon artists! The Pokémon Company has opened a full-time illustrator position focused on creating artwork for Pokémon Sleep. The role includes designing Pokémon sleeping poses using vector illustrations, creating in-game assets such as items, dishes, and environments, checking artwork quality, and directing external illustrators. Applicants need at least two years of professional vector illustration experience, proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, experience matching established character and IP art styles, and a background in the gaming or entertainment industry. The position is based at The Pokémon Company's headquarters in Roppongi, Tokyo, Japan. Apply at: https://hrmos.co/pages/pokemon/jobs/0000147
